capabilities: Show a calendar view in the right sidebar with keyboard navigation
Create and open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes with configurable folders, formats, and templates
Display lunar dates, solar terms, and Chinese public holidays under each day
Highlight custom solar or lunar memorial days
Tint day cells by how many files were created that day (heatmap)
extras: Install is via GitHub Releases or BRAT rather than a community plugin store listing, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes conflict fixes for the Minimal theme and CalcCraft plugin.
intentEvidence: built on top of the classic Calendar Plus plugin with a full rewrite of the note management layer
problem: Obsidian's core daily notes only cover single days and offer no calendar grid for navigating or creating periodic notes, nor Chinese lunar date data.

relations.evidence: built on top of the classic Calendar Plus plugin

summary: Calendar sidebar view that creates and opens daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes, with lunar dates, Chinese holidays, and heatmaps.
